claim: A tactic-route decision can route its exact logical frontier back to the persistent native worker that owns the retained endpoint, restore that opaque process-local checkpoint directly, and execute only the new tactic suffix. Detached handles and mismatched route, state, or boundary identities fail closed.

implementation.checkpoint_serialization: none; the scheduler retains only an opaque process-local restore identity and exact logical state binding
implementation.worker_ownership: dedicated proposal queues preserve stable worker slots; the direct proposal is sent to the slot that produced its source handle
implementation.root_identity: the native session preserves its authenticated root boundary independently from the current cached source so direct and root-replay jobs may alternate
implementation.episode_coordinates: the request remains bound to authenticated root frame 620 while the binary episode shard begins at root plus cached route ticks
implementation.concurrent_seed_scope: direct restore is enabled for a single exploration seed; campaigns with concurrent seed coordinators remain replay-only until per-seed cache ownership is isolated

scope: This closes exact direct restore of a retained frontier and elimination of its replay prefix. Shared-prefix proposal batching, full restore/replay/transition accounting, and concurrent-seed cache ownership remain P2 work.
